relations.subject: n1ql:where-clause
relations.evidence: You can construct complex conditional expressions, for example by using the [logical operators](logicalops.md) `AND`, `OR`, and `NOT`.

notable_absence.finding: No Prerequisites section at all on this page - unlike WITH, WINDOW, and the DDL/DCL statement pages in this batch/registry, WHERE is documented with no privilege table, no credential-type branching, and no capella-role gate whatsoever. This is consistent with WHERE being a pure filtering clause used inside a query whose data access is already gated by the FROM/keyspace-selection privilege elsewhere in the same statement - the docs don't re-state privileges per clause, only per top-level statement/keyspace-access point. Useful negative data point for the batch hypothesis: the credential-type/capella-role model attaches to statements and keyspace-access points, not to every clause.
